notes: 2546 Hylan Blvd, Staten Island, NY 10306. Open 24/7, including holidays; no appointments - call or walk in, and you can call and speak to a doctor first. Its own page says it treats dogs, cats, rabbits, birds and exotic animals. Parking in the driveway to the right of the building. Not on the Mayor's Alliance list; found on VEG's own list of New York hospitals while checking the others.
